Bill.BriefDescription: Providing personal use trailer license fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to personal use trailer license fees; amending RCW46.16.0621; and adding a new section to chapter 46.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.0621 and 2002 c 352 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) License tab fees shall be thirty dollars per year for allvehicles. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license tab fees" aredefined as the general fees paid annually for licensing motor vehiclesand trailers as defined in RCW 46.04.620 and 46.04.623. ((Trailerslicensed under RCW 46.16.068 or 46.16.085 and)) Campers licensed underRCW 46.16.505 are not required to pay license tab fees under thissection.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Private passenger car one or twowheel trailers of two thousandpounds gross weight or less, may be licensed upon the payment of alicense fee in the sum of four dollars and fifty cents or, if the p. 1 SB 6069vehicle was previously licensed in this state and has not beenregistered in another jurisdiction in the intervening period, a renewallicense fee in the sum of three dollars and twentyfive cents, but onlyif such trailers are to be operated upon the public highway by theowners thereof. (2) Private use trailers over two thousand pounds gross weightoperated upon a public highway by the owner of the trailer may belicensed upon the payment of a license fee of twentyseven dollars, orif the trailer was previously licensed in this state and has not beenregistered in another jurisdiction in the intervening period, a renewalfee of twentythree dollars and seventyfive cents. (3) It is the intention of the legislature that the reduced licensefee under this section applies only to trailers operated for personaluse of the owners and not trailers held for rental to the public.
